title: Looking for a cold email outreach expert to help launch my first campaign

facts: Post (read-only Upwork lookup 2026-10-26 3:17 PM CT): first cold email campaign; build a targeted list, write and refine outreach messages, manage sending, track results, clear strategy, improve response rates, ongoing support. Part-time.
Client in Australia. No tools named in the post. No screening questions returned by the lookup.
First name David appears in two separate freelancer reviews of this client (ended 2026-10-26 and 2026-10-23). Not evidenced as owner.
All prospects, companies, domains and counts in this deck are invented samples. The target market is a placeholder until the real offer is agreed.

scenes.beat: We start by agreeing exactly who you want to reach. Then I build the list and check every address, write the three emails, warm up the sending inboxes, and track every reply in one place.
details: Sample target for this demo: {{target.who}}. We swap in your real offer and buyer on the call.
Proposed tools: Apify to find leads, MillionVerifier to check emails, Instantly to send and collect replies.
Sending runs from a separate lookalike domain so your main domain stays protected.
